fragments.title: kafka_header_enricher
fragments.description: Enriches every Kafka record with standard metadata fields for downstream traceability and compliance. Automatically copies Kafka-native attributes (topic, partition, offset, timestamp) from record.attributes into record value fields. Optionally adds custom enrichment fields (source_system, environment, pipeline_name, schema_version) supplied as runtime parameters — set a parameter to a non-empty value to include it, or leave empty to skip. stageOnRecordError=TO_ERROR routes any failed record to the error lane. Use this fragment immediately after the Kafka Consumer origin so every downstream stage has access to the enriched metadata. Works with any Kafka-based use case: banking, oil & gas, manufacturing, public sector. No hardcoded values — all enrichment is configurable at job start via runtime parameters.

fragments.description: Stamps every record with a schema_version header attribute so downstream consumers can handle version-specific parsing. The pipeline-level runtime parameter SCHEMA_VERSION (default '1.0') is resolved via an EL expression into a per-record header attribute named 'schema_version'. Update SCHEMA_VERSION at job start whenever the upstream schema changes — no fragment redeploy needed.
